title: Sports Roundup: Girls Tennis Earns Signature Win, Girls Lacrosse Remains Undefeated, Boys Lax Beats Sandwich - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago This Whaler sports roundup includes an update on the girls tennis team following their first win in program history over the St. John Paul II Lions, the girls lacrosse team following a pair of wins - including one in overtime on the road, the boys lacrosse team following a blowout victory over the Sandwich Blue Knights on the road, the boys tennis team, the sailing team, the baseball team after a road loss, and the softball team after losing their first home game of the season.
